description: §6.7.4 an `<effect deps=[…]>` entry naming a derived cell is E-LIFECYCLE-007 (the `<effect>` limb).
rationale: §6.7.4 Semantics: "Every `deps=` entry SHALL be a declared, mutable reactive cell in scope at the `<effect>`. An undeclared name, a non-`@` name, or a **derived** cell … is **E-LIFECYCLE-007** — a derived value has no change event of its own". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
